title: orders-api: order creation latency 6.4s p95 with 503s
symptom: POST /v2/orders is timing out: p95 6.4s (baseline 180ms) with 503 responses and 'too many clients already' errors from Postgres.
notes: Paged after 5 minutes of sustained latency. Several responders arrive expecting another Redis pool incident - the dependency is a database this time.
